You can't proceed with the conversation because you have a large quantity of items.
Please organize your items and try again.

scripts.speaker: Heart Merchant
scripts.text: Hello! I see you are an adventurer who gives your heart to traveling, uses a boat to sail across the continent, and enjoys the thrill of danger!

scripts.speaker: Heart Merchant
scripts.text: Do you have any {0} in your storage?

scripts.speaker: Heart Merchant
scripts.text: If you bring me a {0}, I'll exchange it to {1}. What do you think? Do you have any idea what this item is?

scripts.speaker: Heart Merchant
scripts.text: Have you ever thought about replacing your {0} to something better? For example... {1}. What do you think?
What is it?
I'm not interested

scripts.speaker: Heart Merchant
scripts.text: {0} is an item that prevents you from losing experience on death once within the 30 minutes duration after use.

scripts.speaker: Heart Merchant
scripts.text: But a lot of people are sad about the time limit, right? So I looked into it and prepared the {0}.

scripts.speaker: Heart Merchant
scripts.text: {0} is an item that will prevent the loss of experience on death once by just having it ^EE0000regardless of the duration^000000. Of course, after death, the {1} is consumed.
Why are you exchanging it?

scripts.speaker: Heart Merchant
scripts.text: Are you curious about that? I'm a merchant. Buying and selling things is my fate, whether it's related to one's life or death. Do you think I'm going to miss this opportunity to make money? I make money, and the living get a leeway from the pain of death. Isn't that a good deal?

scripts.speaker: Heart Merchant
scripts.text: The exchange rate is 5 {0} for 1 {1}. Do you have any questions?

scripts.speaker: Heart Merchant
scripts.text: Hm~ What do you think? Isn't it a fair trade? Do you want to always worry about time? It's a must-have for adventurers who enjoy breathtaking adventures.

scripts.speaker: Heart Merchant
scripts.text: Yeah, yeah. Good decision. It's better to exchange it for a better one, isn't it?

scripts.speaker: Heart Merchant
scripts.text: I can exchange your ^0000cd5 {0} to 1 {1}.

scripts.speaker: Heart Merchant
scripts.text: However, ^EE0000[Not for sale] {0} is not eligible for exchange^000000, so it is useless to bring it here and ask for it to be exchanged.

scripts.speaker: Heart Merchant
scripts.text: Shall we exchange it now?
Exchange it please!
I don't want to exchange it.

scripts.speaker: Heart Merchant
scripts.text: How many do you want to exchange? ^0000cdYou can exchange up to 10 {0} at a time^000000.

scripts.speaker: Heart Merchant
scripts.text: Hm? Are you not interested? This is a great product, and it's really good for someone like you. But if you don't want to protect your live, I won't force you either.

scripts.speaker: Heart Merchant
scripts.text: Like I said, ^0000cdyou can only exchange up to 10^000000 at a time. Check the quantity again.

scripts.speaker: Heart Merchant
scripts.text: Um, excuse me but... you don't have enough {0}, no? It's 5 {1} for 1 {2}. Please check the quantity.

scripts.speaker: Heart Merchant
scripts.text: Now, with this, I've exchanged your ^0000cd{0}^000000 for the ^EE0000{1}^000000!! That was a good deal, wasn't it? The next time you get your hands on a {2}, come see me again!

scripts.speaker: Heart Merchant
scripts.text: This is a great deal! Adventurer, it's a must-have item for people like you who ventures in dangerous places!

scripts.speaker: Heart Merchant
scripts.text: If you become interested in it, be sure to come back for the exchange. Okay?
